OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

circleUpgrader().notice: Circle specified address allowed to call transferUSDCRoles().

returnProxyAdmin().notice: Change admin of the AdminUpgradeabilityProxy to this contract owner. Can only be called by the current contract owner.

returnTokenOwnership().notice: Transfer ownership of the token to this contract owner. Can only be called by the current contract owner. Will revert if this contract is the UpgradeabilityProxy admin because of the proxy limitation - returnProxyAdmin() needs to be called first.

setCircleUpgrader(address).notice: Set Circle address allowed to call transferUSDCRoles(). Can only be called by the current contract owner.

transferUSDCRoles(address).notice: Transfer stablecoin ownership to Circle. 1. callable by an address that Circle specifies closer to the time of the upgrade. 2. Transfers the ProxyAdmin role to the function caller. 3. Transfers the Implementation Owner role to the address specified in the newTokenOwner parameter.

userdoc.notice: The Sonic Gateway contract handling the USDC token ownership. It is intended to hold ownership of both the token and its UpgradeabilityProxy. It allows Circle to acquire the token and proxy ownership. The contract owner can reclaim ownership from this contract.
